headword: {連立政権|れんりつせいけん}

definitions.explanation: a government formed by two or more political parties working together, typically when no single party has enough seats to govern alone

examples.japanese: {連立政権|れんりつせいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発足|ほっそく}→発足：13641_hossoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{連立政権|れんりつせいけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult for a coalition government to agree on policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}れなかった→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{他党|たとう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{連立政権|れんりつせいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Since the ruling party failed to win a majority, it had to form a coalition government with other parties.

notes:
Combines ⟦{連立|れんりつ}→連立：14492_renritsu⟧ (coalition, alliance) and ⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧ (political power, government). Japan has had multiple coalition governments, most notably the long-running LDP-Komeito coalition. The term is a staple of political news coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連立政権|れんりつせいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to form a coalition government
- {連立政権|れんりつせいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for a coalition government to collapse
- {連立政権|れんりつせいけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧: maintenance of a coalition government
- {連立政権|れんりつせいけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枠組|わくぐ}み→枠組み：13117_wakugumi⟧: framework of a coalition government

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単独政権|たんどくせいけん}: single-party government — a government formed by one party alone
- {連立与党|れんりつよとう}: coalition ruling parties — the parties that make up the coalition
- {政権交代|せいけんこうたい}: change of government — when power shifts from one party or coalition to another
